⌈
Service Name
EthTrcv_MacSecDeleteRxSa (draft)
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthTrcv_MacSecDeleteRxSa (

)
Service ID [hex]
0x21
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different TrcvIdx, non reentrant for the same TrcvIdx
TrcvIdx
Index of the Ethernet transceiver within the context of the
Ethernet Transceiver Driver
Parameters (in)
An
Association Number to use in the MACsec’s reception secure
association
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: The request
has not been accepted
Description
Request the Ethernet Transceiver Driver to remove the Reception Secure Association identified
by the provided Association Number.
